dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL dialect used in Japanese medical billing system
evidence: no EXEC SQL/CICS, no COMP-3, fixed format

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance claim (receipt) data validation and extraction subsystem for the JMA ORCA standard receipt software
purpose.summary: ORCGD02 is a batch data-check and extraction program within the JMA ORCA medical receipt system. It validates medical treatment data (diagnoses, insurance numbers, inpatient/outpatient classification, treatment dates, prohibited combinations, etc.) and writes results to output files. The program performs extensive rule-based checks on medical billing records for Japanese health insurance claims.

notable_features: 25 COPY statements with REPLACING for parameterized copybooks
94 CALL statements indicating heavy use of subprograms
322 PERFORM statements with no GOTO (structured programming)
Large OCCURS tables (up to 3000 entries) for medical code validation
Japanese EUC/Shift-JIS encoded comments (latin-1 decoded with mojibake)
4 file SELECT/FD pairs for check condition and error output files
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
Extensive error flag and counter working storage areas
verdict.notes: Comments are in Japanese encoded as EUC-JP or Shift-JIS but decoded as latin-1, resulting in mojibake. The file is large (5705 lines, ~279KB) and clearly production-grade medical billing software. The ORCA project is a well-known open-source Japanese medical receipt system developed by JMA, typically compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux.
